verdict.rationale: Exa has a public pricing page with self-serve, credit-based billing: $20 in credits at sign-up plus $10 per month, with no payment method required. It also documents that contents retrieval is free for up to 10 results per search, so a developer can start and estimate costs without contacting sales. However, the evidence never shows actual per-request or per-credit dollar rates for search, contents, Agent or Websets, so the 'clear per-request pricing' part is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-request or per-credit price figures for each endpoint, a published rate schedule for higher tiers or enterprise use, and independent corroboration that pricing is clear.
